Chief_Complaint.content: 3 days of diarrhea; loose/watery stools; near-constant toilet needs; affects day-to-day activities.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: 3 days of diarrhea; loose/watery stools; near-constant toilet needs; affects day-to-day activities.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Diarrhea started ~3 days ago; ~6–7 stools/day; stool watery, no blood.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: HPI: diarrhea started ~3 days ago; ~6–7 stools/day; stool watery, no blood.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Crampy left lower quadrant abdominal pain; intermittent.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Crampy left lower quadrant abdominal pain; intermittent.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Weak, shaky sensation; feverish at onset (felt hot ~3–4 days ago); no measured fever now.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Weak, shaky sensation; feverish at onset (felt hot ~3–4 days ago); no measured fever now.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No vomiting currently; initial vomiting at onset but resolved.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No vomiting currently; initial vomiting at onset but resolved.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Appetite decreased; able to hold fluids.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Appetite: decreased; able to hold fluids.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Diet tolerated soups, smoothies, liquid foods.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Diet: tolerated soups, smoothies, liquid foods.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Triggers: Chinese takeaway ~4 days ago; otherwise normal diet.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Triggers: Chinese takeaway ~4 days ago; otherwise normal diet.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Wife and two kids at home; one child had vomiting but not diarrhea; no similar symptoms in family.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Family: wife and two kids at home; one child had vomiting but not diarrhea; no similar symptoms in family.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Symptoms requiring frequent bathroom breaks; still going to work but difficult.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: ADLs: symptoms requiring frequent bathroom breaks; still going to work but difficult.

Assessment.content: Acute gastroenteritis, likely viral, with diarrhea (6–7x/day), left lower quadrant crampy pain, prior vomiting, and mild systemic symptoms; no hematochezia or dehydration documented.
Assessment.source_text: Assessment: 1) Acute gastroenteritis, likely viral, with diarrhea (6–7x/day), left lower quadrant crampy pain, prior vomiting, and mild systemic symptoms; no hematochezia or dehydration documented.

Plan_of_Care.content: Hydration: oral rehydration (Dioralyte); maintain fluid intake.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Hydration: oral rehydration (Dioralyte); maintain fluid intake.

Plan_of_Care.content: Diet: light/liquid foods as tolerated; avoid heavy meals.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Diet: light/liquid foods as tolerated; avoid heavy meals.

Plan_of_Care.content: Activity: rest; take 2–3 days off work.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Activity: rest; take 2–3 days off work.

Plan_of_Care.content: Antibiotics: not indicated at this time (conservative management).
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Antibiotics: not indicated at this time (conservative management).

Follow_up_Information.content: Reassess in 3–4 days; return earlier if symptoms worsen or fail to improve.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Follow-up: reassess in 3–4 days; return earlier if symptoms worsen or fail to improve.

Follow_up_Information.content: Investigations: stool sample/testing considered if persistent beyond 3–4 days or if symptoms fail to improve; stool culture if indicated.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Investigations: stool sample/testing considered if persistent beyond 3–4 days or if symptoms fail to improve; stool culture if indicated.
